newsitem.title: ITALY: Finmeccanica secures 3.0 trln lire loan.
newsitem.headline: Finmeccanica secures 3.0 trln lire loan.

text.p: State-controlled engineering group Finmeccanica has secured a three trillion lire seven-year rolling credit from 27 Italian credit institutions, the group said in a statement on Tuesday.
Finmeccanica said the credit facility would enable it to reduce its financing costs.

It said Vitale Borghesi and Cofiri organised the operation with Banca Commerciale Italiana, Banco di Napoli, Banca di Roma, Banca Nazionale del Lavoro, Istituto Bancario San Paolo and Credito Italiano also participating.

Finmeccanica ended 1996 with net debts of 5.1 trillion lire, up from 4.9 trillion lire the year before. This compares with net assets of 4.4 trillion lire at the end of last year. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
